newsitem.title: FRANCE: Dassault 1996 net attrib profit rises.
newsitem.headline: Dassault 1996 net attrib profit rises.

text.p: (Figures in millions of French francs unless stated)

NOTE - Aircraft maker Dassault Aviation gave its results in a statement. It said the large profit increase was mainly due to capital gains on the flotation of Dassault Systemes, and rises in financial products and foreign exchange.
It received orders totalling 11.14 billion francs, of which 75 percent came from exports. Orders for 1995 totalled 14.22 billion francs.

Civilian markets accounted for 69 percent of 1996 orders and for 52 percent of turnover. French government sales accounted for 28 percent of turnover. The company paid a 1995 net dividend of 8.50 francs and had turnover of 11.59 billion francs.
The parent company Dassault Aviation had net treasury of 8.5 billion francs.
It gave no details of the capital gains on the Dassault Systemes initial public offering.
Dassault Aviation is in merger negotiations with state-owned Societe Nationale Industrielle Aerospatiale.
